ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens: loose leaves in green and dark red-purple, some ruffled and frilly, some flat and smooth, scattered across the bowl, moist with a slight sheen, leaves about 5-10 cm long, sitting in the base and mixed with other items | 60
ITEM 2 | Avocado: pale green flesh with darker green skin edges, sliced into about 6 crescent-shaped wedges roughly 8-10 cm long and 1-2 cm thick, smooth glossy surface, arranged in a fan on the right and center of the greens | 110
ITEM 3 | Red onion: thin translucent white and pale purple-edged rings and slivers, about 0.3 cm thick, loosely scattered among the leaves and avocado, moist and slightly glossy | 25
ITEM 4 | Purple onion pieces: small chunks and rings of deep purple-red onion, tucked among the greens near the center-top, moist and slightly glossy | 8
ITEM 5 | Dark green strips: a few elongated flat green leaf pieces or herb strands, about 6-8 cm long, dull surface, lying on the right edge of the salad | 10
